hashgen.mdd: I'll take its fingerprint for you.
hashgen.ph.input: The string you want a hash of
hashgen.note: MD5 and SHA-1 have known collisions — use them only to check integrity, never to store passwords. SHA3-512 is the standard (same value as sha3sum); Keccak-512 predates standardisation and gives a different value.
hashgen.err.lib: Could not load the hashing library. Try reloading the page.
hashgen.caveat.SHA3_512: The standard (FIPS-202). Same value as sha3sum and openssl dgst -sha3-512.
hashgen.caveat.KECCAK512: The pre-standard SHA-3. Differs from sha3sum — use it only to match older tools.
hashgen.label.file: Choose a file (dropping one works too)
hashgen.ph.expect: Paste the checksum the publisher gave you and it tells you whether it matches
hashgen.match.no: No hash matches. The file is damaged, or it is a different file.
